product.name: Aurelio PercuLite 3-Piece Kit
product.description: The Aurelio PercuLite 3-Piece Kit offers a compact yet resonant percussion experience for beginners and hobbyists. It includes a wooden snare drum, a metal hi‑hat stand, and an acrylic tom‑tom, all finished in a deep ebony lacquer. The kit is lightweight, weighing just over 2.5 kg, and can be easily transported or stored. Designed for acoustic play, it delivers clear, balanced tones without the need for amplification. Ideal for home practice, classroom ensembles, or small jam sessions, the PercuLite kit provides versatility and durability in a single package.
